usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/grok/generate with JSON body {prompt, aspect_ratio?} -> {jobId, status:"pending"}; then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX, free) until status:"complete"
usage.outputShape: Generate returns body.jobId + body.status ("pending"). Poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId}: image at body.result.imageUrl (PNG on Vercel Blob); also body.status, body.progress, body.input.aspect_ratio, body.error
quirks: Async two-step: POST returns {jobId,status:pending}, NOT the image. Must poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} until status:complete (grok image ~3s, usually one poll).
Job polling is SIWX-authenticated (free, no payment) AND wallet-scoped: the SIWX signer MUST be the SAME wallet that paid for the generate call - a different wallet gets 403 Unauthorized.
Paid on Base via x402 ($0.07 fixed), despite the stale prior usage note claiming Solana - generate accepted Base x402 fine.
Registry/correct host is stablestudio.dev; the old existingUsage callShape host api.xona-agent.com is stale/wrong.
result.imageUrl (Vercel Blob) expires after ~20 minutes - download the image immediately on completion.
Default aspect_ratio is 16:9 when omitted; optional aspect_ratio supports 1:1|16:9|9:16|4:3|3:4|3:2|2:3|2:1|1:2|19.5:9|9:19.5|20:9|9:20.
Do NOT resubmit while a job is pending - duplicate submissions create duplicate paid jobs.
usage.guide: Generate an image by POSTing to https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/grok/generate with JSON {"prompt":"<text>"} (optional "aspect_ratio"); pay the $0.07 x402 charge on Base. The response is an async job: {jobId, status:"pending"} - it does NOT contain the image. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} using SIGN-IN-WITH-X auth (free) with the SAME wallet that paid (a different wallet gets 403); grok image is ~3s so usually one poll. When body.status == "complete", read the PNG from body.result.imageUrl and download it immediately because the URL expires in ~20 minutes.
